purpose: Operational scheduling only; retain frozen scientific requests and completed judgments
authorization: EXAMPLE ONLY: configure endpoints and obtain consent before any API requests.

tokenhub_rate_limit.scope: Both audit jobs jointly, conservatively treating the supplied API credential as one quota; unrelated tasks cannot be controlled by this limiter.

retry_policy: Preserve protocol.json retry budget and backoffs. For 429/503, share an additional provider-wide cooldown of 15 seconds. Apply the same start-rate limiter to retries. Never change the prompt, model, reasoning controls or token budget.
resume_policy: Stop only verified old audit worker PIDs. Preserve and hash all existing attempt/record files before resuming. Save prior execution and status metadata separately. An interrupted in-flight call with no persisted answer is a transport interruption, not a discarded judgment. Existing schema-valid answers are never re-requested.
provenance: Keep Qwen and DeepSeek scientific identities unchanged. Freeze the wrapper and this scheduling specification in a separate operational manifest. Attach operational identity to new attempts and execution metadata; keep old attempts byte-for-byte. Terra receives a new extension identity.
pre_resume_tests: All Qwen/DeepSeek formal request hashes match the unchanged base runner
Simultaneous TokenHub admissions never exceed three starts in a rolling second
Existing record and attempt files retain their hashes
Terra Responses parser records medium effort and token metadata but never hidden reasoning text
